rules.rule: No abbreviations in user-visible strings; dates through @repo/formatting
rules.method: A) literals: rg -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' -g '!**/tests/**' -g '!**/__fixtures__/**' -g '!**/__mocks__/**' -g '!**/node_modules/**' -g '!**/.next/**' -n -e '[0-9}] ?(pts|hrs?|mins?|secs?)\b[^-:=(\[\w]' -e '\$\{\w*([Ss]econds|[Mm]inutes|[Hh]ours)\w*\}[hms]\b' -e '\btmrw\b' -e '(weekday|month): *"(short|narrow)"' -e '\} h`' apps/web | rg -v '^[^:]+:\d+:\s*(//|\*|/\*|\{/\*)' | rg -v className  B) calls to shared formatters whose output is abbreviated: rg -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' -g '!**/tests/**' -g '!**/__fixtures__/**' -g '!**/__mocks__/**' -g '!**/node_modules/**' -g '!**/.next/**' -n '\b(formatPointsChip|formatMinutesExact|formatMinutesRounded|eventLengthLabel|durationLabel|hoursLabel|formatConversationTime|formatGraduationYear)\(' apps/web | rg -v 'function '  C) (listed apart, not in count) formatters bypassing @repo/formatting: rg -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' -g '!**/tests/**' -g '!**/__fixtures__/**' -g '!**/__mocks__/**' -g '!**/node_modules/**' -g '!**/.next/**' -n -e '\.toLocale(Date|Time)String\(' -e 'new Intl\.(DateTimeFormat|RelativeTimeFormat|DurationFormat)\(' apps/web
rules.precision_note: A is exact for the listed tokens and finds only 6 literal sites (2 '+N pts' in the sign-in showcase, 'min', ' h', '${secondsLeft}s', weekday:'short'); most abbreviations are produced by SHARED formatters, so a web-only ratchet on literals misses them: formatPointsChip -> '+10 pts' (packages/formatting/src/display.ts:201), formatMinutesExact/Rounded -> '2h 30m' (minutes.ts), eventLengthLabel -> '30 min' / '1.5 hrs' (packages/validation/src/event-form-rows.ts:118), formatGraduationYear -> "'27" (packages/hooks/src/profile-stats.ts:70; no direct web call, reaches web via the profile subline), formatConversationTime uses month:'short'. No date-fns/dayjs in apps/web, so no 'EEE'/'MMM' tokens. Of the 11 date bypasses, 10 use long forms (weekday/month 'long'); only events-time-grid.tsx:175 is weekday:'short'. .toLocaleString() number formatting (not dates) is listed apart.

[A-Z]|Until you|lets you|allows you|you.ll|Pick (a|an|the|one)|Choose (a|an|the|who|how)\b[^\"]{12,}|Drag|Type (a|an|the)|Enter (a|an|the|your)\b[^\"]{12,}) Proxy B (context, in breakdown): '\bhint=' (ProfileSection/field helper lines), '\bdescription=' (toasts, dialogs, error tiles), '
rules.precision_note: Not regex-countable; a phrase list. Read 70 of the 139 proxy-A lines: about 30 are narration/directions, about 25 are validation or error copy that legitimately says what to do ('Pick a date.', 'Enter a valid amount'), about 15 are other false positives (labels such as 'Choose file', pointer hints such as 'Drag to resize'). So precision is roughly 45%. Recall is poor for the biggest class: settings `hint=` sentences (48, nearly all explain the control or say 'Changes are written to the chapter audit log' - 6 copies of that sentence) mostly do not contain a listed phrase. 'Try again' error copy (about 70 strings) was deliberately excluded.
